verdict.rationale: Expensify is a SaaS platform with a public Integration Server API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents API credentials and OAuth flows but never mentions a sandbox, test mode or non-production environment. The GitHub items about a local dev server and simulator testing cover building the open-source App itself, not an isolated test environment for API users' data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
